metas.name: 1 · ★ 8.1 · 1984 · The Terminator
metas.description: A cyborg assassin from the future attempts to find and kill a young woman who is destined to give birth to a warrior that will lead a resistance to save humankind from extinction.

metas.name: 2 · ★ 8.6 · 1991 · Terminator 2: Judgment Day
metas.description: A cyborg from the future, identical to the one who failed to kill Sarah Connor, must now protect her ten-year-old son John from an even more advanced and powerful cyborg.

metas.name: 3 · ★ 6.3 · 2003 · Terminator 3: Rise of the Machines
metas.description: John Connor must face a female Terminator with power over all the machines. But a new Terminator unit, a T-850, is sent back through time to help guide him through the coming battle.

metas.name: 4 · ★ 6.5 · 2009 · Terminator Salvation
metas.description: As the machines prepare for a final attack, John Connor and a mysterious stranger delve into the heart of Skynet and uncover a terrible secret involving the annihilation of mankind.

metas.name: 5 · ★ 6.3 · 2015 · Terminator Genisys
metas.description: When John Connor, leader of the human resistance, sends Sgt. Kyle Reese back to 1984 to protect Sarah Connor and safeguard the future, an unexpected turn of events creates a fractured timeline.

metas.name: 6 · ★ 6.2 · 2019 · Terminator: Dark Fate
metas.description: An augmented human and Sarah Connor must stop an advanced liquid Terminator from hunting down a young girl, whose fate is critical to the human race.
